sentences.text:
The applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Fir No.26 of 2024 dated 07.08.2024, under Section 420
Ipc, Police Station Mallital, District Nainital.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the co-accused Pradeep Khandelwal sold a property to the informant which had already been mortgaged with the bank, thereby the informant was cheated.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant did not execute any sale-deed;
he did not receive any money; there are vague allegations against him in the FIR.

5. State to file objections.
6. List on 27.11.2024.
7.

Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witness in the case.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
